product_baseline.page_evidence_policy: Only the fact IDs below may be cited as page_validated evidence. Alexa summaries, real-time price/delivery/inventory, review percentages, frequent-return notices, and medical-treatment claims are excluded.

facts.claim: The page title identifies a women's arch-support flip flop / thong sandal.
Outer material is Ethylene Vinyl Acetate (EVA).
The page states super lightweight and breathable.
The page states an upgraded soft toe post.
The page states ergonomic arch support and proper alignment for all-day comfort.
Seamless EVA construction is stated as easy to clean.
A deep textured lattice outsole is stated to provide grip and slip-resistant steps.
The visible size selector includes US sizes 6 through 11.
The visible color selectors include black, pink/mauve, brown, dark gray, light blue, and white.
